description: This file defines an extension to the Process class in Swift, adding a method to run the process and read data from a specified pipe until EOF to prevent blocking.

classes.name: Process
classes.description: A built-in class in Foundation used to execute system processes.

methods.name: runAndReadToEnd(from:)
methods.description: Executes the Process, reads all remaining data from the provided Pipe safely, waits for process termination, and returns the accumulated Data.
